title: Diamond Upgrades
description: This datapack lets you upgrade your iron tools and armor into diamond tools and armor using a flower and a smithing table!
body:
# Summary
This datapack lets you upgrade your iron tools and armor into diamond tools and armor using a flower and a smithing table!

---

# Description
Using a small flower, your iron tools or armor, and a diamond, you can upgrade your tools to diamond in an instant, similarly to netherite upgrades. Netherite upgrades are used for diamond to netherite, while small flowers are used for iron to diamond.

---

### WARNING

Your game might say that the pack will break your world, though it works perfectly fine. Ignore the message and use anyways.
